 評論及分析： 
工業龍頭 CAT 業績遠超預期並上調預期。開盤前一度大漲超過 9%，惟後續
拉回收漲 5.6%。市場觀察 CAT 主要挑戰包括：訂單積壓強勁，但未來上行
力度或更多挑戰；雖然業績亮眼，但有一次性因素；下半年利潤率改善路徑
仍有待觀察。考量 CAT 目前所有業務都呈現穩健成長，而非僅靠 AI 相關，
看到基礎設施⽀出、租賃⾞隊、採礦投資以及 AI 驅動的電力需求將⽀撐成
長。產能擴張計劃不完全依賴 資料中⼼，還涵蓋⽯油天然氣、採礦、海運以
及不斷增長的裝機基礎，未來望獲得售後市場服務收入的機會。 
公司財報重點數據： 
2Q26 營收達 205.4 億美元，年成長 24%，為公司歷史上首次單季營收突破
200 億美元。調整後 EPS 為 8.17 美元，年增 73%，高於市場預期 6.20 美
元；調整後營業利益 45 億美元，調整後營業利益率 21.9%，年增 430 個基
點。積壓訂單達 721 億美元，季增超過 90 億美元，其中 59%預計於未來 12
個月內交付。公司透過股票回購與股息共返還股東 22 億美元資本。2Q26 關
稅成本(不含 IEEPA 退稅)約 4 億美元，優於 4 月估計的 7 億美元，本季另認
列 IEEPA 關稅退稅 3.92 億美元  
公司業績表現： 
(1).電力與能源：營收 82.4 億美元，年增 17%，發電營收年增 29%，主因資
料中⼼用大型往復式引擎(Large Reciprocating Engines )、渦輪機及相關服
務需求強勁；⽯油與天然氣營收年增 9%；工業用引擎營收年增 9%。終端用
戶銷售整體年增 33%， 其中發電終端銷售年增高達72%。 為因應資料中⼼用
電需求 ， 公司宣布恢復生產10MW 中速燃氣往復式引擎平台 ， 新增約1.5GW
產能，第四季開始出貨；惟部分產品交期已延伸至 2028 至 2029 年，顯示產
能仍偏緊。 
(2).建築：營收 83.5 億美元，年增 35%，分區域來看，北美年增 50%，拉丁
美洲年增 25%，歐非中東年增 23%，亞太年增 3%。終端用戶銷售連續第六
季成長，年增 22%，主要受惠於北美租賃機隊裝載強勁及非住宅、住宅營建
設備銷售暢旺 。 本季公司首度交付設備予Major Projects(與經銷商合資成立 、
聚焦大型基礎建設專案的全國性租賃平台） 。 管理層提及中東地區終端需求偏
軟，為區域表現中的隱憂。 
(3).資源：營收 46.5 億美元，年增 20%，終端用戶銷售年增 17%，礦業、重
型營建及砂⽯骨材需求皆優於去年同期，鐵路業務成長則來自國際機⾞交付
增加。 
(4).金融產品：營收 11.5 億美元，年增 10%，客戶財務體質維持穩健，逾期
繳款比率降至 1.31%，為 1998 年以來最低；備抵呆帳比率降至 0.84%，創
歷史新低。

公司展望與產業前景：
(1).全年營收成長展望由先前的低雙位數上修至中高雙位數。
(2).全年調整後營業利益率展望優於先前預期，下半年關稅對調整後營業利益
與利益率的衝擊預計不顯著，公司不再預期下半年會有額外的 IEEPA 關稅退
稅，全年關稅成本從原先預估 22 到 24 億美元下修至約 22 億美元。
(3).全年 ME&T 自由現金流展望上修至 60 億至 150 億美元目標區間的上半
段；儘管資本⽀出增加，下半年 ME&T 自由現金流預估仍將略高於上半年。
2026 年資本⽀出預估約 35 億美元，與先前預期相近。
(4).管理層表示 ，AI 資料中⼼帶動的發電設備需求為主要成長動能之一 ， 電力
與能源客戶訂單能見度已延伸至 2030 年，但仍面臨產能吃緊、部分產品交
付期延長。建築產業下半年經銷商庫存水位可能對銷售量成長構成壓力，第
四季通常會出現季節性庫存去化。
備註：ME&T 指公司建築產業、資源產業、電力與能源三大實體設備部門
電話會議 Q&A 重點摘要：
(1).資料中⼼以外的引擎與渦輪機訂單是否也在走強，動能延續性：管理層表

示在⽯油與天然氣、尤其是天然氣壓縮領域看到強勁需求，預期未來幾年天
然氣輸送量將大幅提升；大型引擎同時應用於採礦設備與船舶市場，目前尚
未看到任何客戶減少需求，訂單積壓反而持續拉長。
(2).下半年公司是否計畫依終端需求生產，或需考量通路回補庫存的影響：管
理層認為目前的積壓訂單反映公司產能尚未完全跟上終端需求，只要終端銷
售持續正成長即屬正面訊號，管理層對下半年展望偏樂觀。
(3).未來二至四季，建築產業銷售量成長是否放緩 ：管理層表示建築產業在
2025 年上半年基期較低、下半年才加速成長並延續至 2026 年上半年，此基
期效應須納入下半年年增率比較考量。
公司簡介、競爭對手與公司自身價值：
Caterpillar 是全球最大的營建與採礦設備製造商 ， 主要業務涵蓋建築 、 資源 、
電力與能源(含發電機組、油氣設備、工業渦輪機、柴電機⾞)及金融產品四大
板塊。公司產品線涵蓋挖土機、推土機、礦用卡⾞、發電機組、燃氣渦輪機及
柴電機⾞等，並透過全球經銷商網絡提供設備銷售、租賃與售後服務。

2458 義隆(ELAN)

報告日期： 2026/08/06 研 究 員：羅  金 鳳 (Sunny Lo)  
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 記憶體、 CPU 缺貨漲價的影響為 2H26 觀察重點  
因 AI 需求強勁帶動各上下游零組件呈現供給短缺 ， DRAM、CPU、
MLCC 、Foundry 在 2Q26 持續漲價，對消費性電子產品需求產生
不同程度的負面影響，但義隆電憑藉優異的技術及快速導入 AI 相
關的功能，降低營運受影響的情況， 2Q26 整體營收 32.05 億元，
QoQ-0.62% ，YoY+5.71% ，毛利率僅些微受原物料上漲的影響，
為 47.39% ，且在業外貝獻約 2.94 億元下，稅後淨利 8.79 億元， 
QoQ+24.68% ，YoY+148.49% ，稅後 EPS 2.89 元，合計 1H26
稅後 EPS 5.21 元。

2H26 義隆電 AI 相關的產品仍繼續成長，但原物料及半導體供應
鏈漲價的情況持續 ，CPU 及記憶體的缺貨漲價將使 PC/NB 需求面
臨挑戰， 2H26 消費性電子產品的旺季需求可能受到影響，加上之
前所備的低價原物料已快消耗完畢，使 2H26 的營運表現相對辛
苦，不過義隆電已於 7/1 針對不同客戶及不同產品進行 5～10+%
的漲價，將減緩不利的影響，因此，我們預估義隆電 3Q26 營收
31.94 億元， QoQ-0.34% ，YoY-3.68% ，稅後 EPS 2.01 元。

二. HAPTIC 、ADAS 、無人機營收增，且朝 CPO 前進  
義隆電持續進產品多元化， 2026 年包括 NB 及 Non-NB 的產品將
有明顯進展，其中應用於 NB 的 HAPTIC 於 2022 年即開始出貨，
但過去 3～4 年為耕耘期，出貨量的成長相對較慢，由於 2026 年
起 Windows 的作業軟體 (OS) 開始內嵌 HAPTIC 的功能 ， 同時美系
客戶將其全系列的 NB 導入 HAPTIC 功能，義隆電也將成本由 20
美元降至 10 美元，有助 HAPTIC 加速導入。

無人機及 ADAS 是義隆電近年在 NB 之外積極耕耘的項目，其中
無人機方面，由於義隆電的雲台及避障功能模組可比競爭對手有
低功耗 (可省去散熱板 )，模組體積也較輕薄短小的優點，成為客戶
Cost down 最佳選擇，且義隆電 Mini-LED 的 Local dimming 面板
在極寒的氣候、戴手套的情況下也可操作靈敏，且具防水、觸控
功能，因此，在國內已與數家無人機標案公司合作，模組化的高
ASP 將帶動義隆電 2H26 來自無人機的營收貢獻將開始放大，且
後續 ASP 高達 500 美元的 Camera + AI Box 也已通過認證 ， 開始
出貨，具避障功能的無人機也將於 2026 底完成。

三. 預估 2026/2027 年年稅後 EPS 9.24/10.47 元 
2026 年在 AI PC 滲透率上升、商用機種出貨比重上升、 HAPTIC
貢獻大幅成長、無人機出貨以高單價的模組化為主，帶動義隆電
2026 年營運大幅優於 NB 產業的表現 ， 因此 ， 我們預估義隆電2026
年營收 127.73 億元 ，YoY+3.62%，毛 利 率47.23%，稅 後 淨 利28.09
億元， YoY+15.02% ，稅後 EPS 9.24 元。 2027 年 PC/NB 需求可
望恢復平穩，加上 HAPTIC 、ADAS 、無人機的貢獻放大，因此，
我們預估義隆電 2027 年營收 142.44 億元， YoY+11.51% ，毛利
率 47.21% ，稅後淨利 31.82 億元， YoY+13.3% ，稅後 EPS 10.47
元。

四. 投資建議為買進，目標價 209 元 
雖然目前因全球經濟環境不確定性高，但義隆電持續進行技術升
級及產品組合的優化，獲利表現仍能較全球 NB 產業的狀況佳，
邊緣 AI 的發展加速將帶動 2026 年 AI PC 的滲透率優於 2025 年，
有利義隆電的 Haptic 及 Fingerprint 出貨量成長 ， 加上義隆電晶片
設計的附加價值將比過往明顯提升，反映在 ASP 上將比傳統機種
高出 10% 以上，有利營運在大環境不佳的情況下保持韌性，加上
成功脫胎換骨，打入軍用無人機及進軍矽光子領域，有利未來營
運表現，因此，投資建議維持買進，目標價 209 元(20x2027 稅後
EPS) 。

二.營運概況及展望

1、預估 2026 年全球 NB 出貨 YoY-5.26% 
在新冠疫情過後，及通膨的影響，品牌廠持續進行庫存去化，使
全球 NB 需求在 2022 年及 2023 年急速下降，在進行約 6～8 個
季度的庫存去化後，需求開始回穩，雖然要回到疫情期間的年增
雙位數不易 ， 但需求大致走穩 ， 使2024 年全球出貨量回升到 1.95
億台，YoY+2.42% ，2025 年在 Windows 10 EOL 及疫情期間購買
的 NB 逐漸進入換機潮的帶動下 ， 全球NB 出貨量持續呈現小幅成
長，預估為 2.02 億台， YoY+3.13% ，預估 2026 年在 AI 訓練需求
強勁了 3 年後 ， 推論的需求將開始接棒成長 ， 有利AI PC 的導入，
帶動全球 NB 成長，不過因為 AI 強勁的需求，且進入推理的代理
人 AI 後，對這憶體需求大幅成長，帶動 2Q25 後記憶體需求大幅
成長，呈現明顯供不應求，帶動記憶體報價爆漲，在記憶體價格
漲勢未歇的情況下，將影響終端的消費性電子產品，因此，預估
2026 年全球 NB 出貨量將下滑至 1.71 億台， YoY-15.18% 。

2、增加產品附加價值提升營運成長 
儘管 NB 市場成長已達高原期 ， 未來再大幅成長可能性相對較低，
義隆電除了持續往資訊安全領域發展，在現有的指紋解鎖 IC 產品
增加防假指紋及加密功能，提升產品競爭力外，未來將增加更多
IC 的 Total Solution ，有利 IC 銷售單價倍數提升，讓整體營運成
長優於 NB 市場的成長性。

叁、業 績 及 獲 利 預 估

1、預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 2.01 元 
2H26 義隆電 AI 相關的產品仍繼續成長，但原物料及半導體供應
鏈漲價的情況持續 ，CPU 及記憶體的缺貨漲價將使 PC/NB 需求面
臨挑戰， 2H26 消費性電子產品的旺季需求可能受到影響，加上之
前所備的低價原物料已快消耗完畢，使 2H26 的營運表現相對辛
苦，不過義隆電已於 7/1 針對不同客戶及不同產品進行 5～10+%
的漲價，將減緩不利的影響，因此，我們預估義隆電 3Q26 營收
31.94 億元， QoQ-0.34% ，YoY-3.68% ，稅後 EPS 2.01 元。

2、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 9.24/10.47 元 
2026 年在 AI PC 滲透率上升、商用機種出貨比重上升、 HAPTIC
貢獻大幅成長、無人機出貨以高單價的模組化為主，帶動義隆電
2026 年營運大幅優於 NB 產業的表現 ， 因此 ， 我們預估義隆電2026
年營收 127.73 億元 ，YoY+3.62%，毛 利 率47.23%，稅 後 淨 利28.09

研究部對義隆電的投資建議調降至中立，係因(1)2Q26 本業獲利受
到成本侵蝕，不如預期，(2)受到 CPU 缺貨影響，對3Q26 營收及獲
利有所下修，(3)下修下半年的營運動能至低於上半年 ，(4)下修 26
年獲利預估，(5)期待無人機貢獻有更進一步的提升 ，綜合以上，
下修義隆電 26 年 EPS 預估為 9.36 元(原估 9.83 元，+16.5%YOY)，
及預估 27 年 EPS 為 10.14 元，+8.3%YOY)。 研究部先前給予的目標
價 158 元到價後，因為 NB 市場除了先前的記憶體影響外，目前更
受到 CPU 缺貨的影響，短線上義隆電的營運動能受到連帶影響大，
故將投資建議調降至中立，目標價 172 元。

重點摘要： 
1. 2Q26 各項財務數字皆落在財測下緣：  
義隆電2Q26 營收為落在財測區間下緣的 32.05 億元(財測
為 32-34 億元)，衰退0.6%QOQ，成長5.7%YOY，營收下滑
研究員推估為客戶提前備貨逐步告一段落所致。毛利率下
滑至 47.4%(財測區間為 46.5%-49.5%之間)，主要還是受
到各元件及晶圓代工與封測漲價，遞延反映給客戶導致毛
利率下滑 。 而OPM 為 21.76%(財測為 21.4-25.9%)之間 ， 整
體本業不如預期。而業外因為持有 6698 旭輝應材的評價
利益，加上轉投資益鼎投資的利益大幅貢獻約 2.5 億元以
上，使稅後淨利為大幅優於市場預期的 8.79 億元，成長
24.7%QOQ， 成長149%YOY，EPS 2.89 元。2Q26 產品組合為 ：
AI 12% ，觸控 70%，非觸控 18%，其中 TOUCH PAD 38%，
TOUCH SCREEN 21% ， 指 紋 11% ，POINT STICK 1 5% ，
MCU+SENSOR 3%。

2. 3Q26 未給展望，但受到 CPU 缺貨影響嚴重： 
義隆電因為最近四季合併（個別）財務報表營業外收支淨
額合計數占稅前損益合計數之絕對值大於 10%，在法說會
中不能提及預測性資訊，但在法說會有提到 CPU 缺貨狀況
比預期嚴重，加上記憶體持續高漲影響消費者購買需求，
另外客戶提前備貨也告一段落，故預告下半年動能將低於
上半年。故下修義隆電3Q26 營收預估為 30.85 億元(原估
35.3 億元)，衰退3.7%QOQ，衰退6.9%YOY，稅後淨利同步
下修預估為 6.23 億元(原估 7.84 億元)，衰退29.1%QOQ，
衰退 22.5%YOY，EPS 2.05 元(原估 2.58 元)。

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要批露及免責聲明  2

3. 期待無人機貢獻性加大： 
1H26 營收占比約低個位數 ， 主 要 出 Mini LED local 
dimming 及 ISP 晶片，單價約在個位數至十位數美金，。
不過下半年開始出相關的 AI BOX，目前已經出貨至國內無
人機廠商，整合鏡頭模組及視覺導航等功能，單價從數十
美金到數百美金不等，整體營收有望達到中高個位數。展
望 27 年，在高單價的 AI BOX 及整合相關模組開始順利出
貨下，推估營收占比有望達到雙位數。

4. 下修26年預估，27年將緩步成長： 
2Q26受到客戶已經提前拉貨影響，加上相關零組件及封裝
成本提升，使得2Q26義隆電本業獲利不如預期，所幸業外
獲利大幅挹注，使得2Q26 EPS大幅優於預期。然而，3Q26 
PC相關供應鏈受到CPU缺貨及DRAM漲價壓抑買氣，故有所
下修 。 綜合以上 ， 下修26年營收預估為126.8億元(原估137
億元)， 成長2.9%YOY， 稅後淨利同步下修預估為28.46億元
(原估29.87億元)，成長16.5%YOY，EPS 9.36元(原估9.83
元)。 展望27年 ， 目前研究部以27年NB整體出貨量低個位數
增長，加上義隆電無人機相關產品推進至整合型產品，單
價大幅提升下，預估27年營收為140億元，成長10.4%YOY，
稅後淨利預估為30.8億元，成長8.3%YOY，EPS 10.14元。

For the month of August 2026, we estimate AirTAC’s monthly revenue will slightly 
decline to Rmb828mn (-1% MoM, +35% YoY)/NT$3,934mn (-1% MoM, +52% YoY) 
We expect August revenue will go down by 1% MoM to Rmb828mn/NT$3,934mn, 
mainly due to 6% less working days in Mainland China, while the growth remains strong 
from key customers (including battery, electronics and machine tools) and overall 
pneumatic UTR remains high at 100% despite in the low seasons. The company’s 
backlog continues to increase as of the end of July, and we expect shipment to be solid 
in August in order to fulfill these undelivered orders, thus we believe the overall daily 
revenue in August should be higher than July (Rmb31.0mn vs. Rmb29.8mn).

Investment view: Shipment and order continue to be better than expected since 2026 
start. Maintain positive view on AirTAC 
We reiterate our Buy rating on AirTAC, as we remain positive on the company’s previous 
comment on the (1) solid 2026 revenue outlook, which is expected to see 20%+ YoY 
growth (see here), and (2) a prolonged upcycle that could last longer at 2-3 years this 
time with robust performance expected to sustain across multiple end markets, 
including battery/electronics/automotive/machine tools. Furthermore, the company will

### Page 3

continue to enhance internal operational efficiency to mitigate the ongoing risk of higher 
raw material costs amid geopolitical uncertainties. Moreover, the company remains 
committed to maintain a stable pricing strategy in the China pneumatic market, which 
we believe should support further market share gains. We continue to see backlog 
accumulation and expect the company to maintain a high UTR to effectively digest the 
growing order backlog. 
Also, we believe AirTAC’s strong B/S and healthy cash flow position will help the 
company to overcome potential industry demand risks, and further supporting market 
share gains during industry downturns (AirTAC’s share gains have accelerated during 
industry downcycles historically, due to its solid B/S and cash flow management). We 
expect the company’s ROE to continue to rise in the coming years (ROE should improve 
to 26.2% in 2028E per GSe vs. 16%-17% in 2022-25) supporting a high dividend payout 
ratio (50%-60%+ per year per GSe) in coming years. 
Maintain Buy on AirTAC with an unchanged 12m TP of NT$1,925. 
Investment Thesis - AirTAC 
AirTAC is the 2nd-largest pneumatic supplier in mainland China with 28% market share 
in 2025, outpacing most local competitors, owing to its low-cost yet high quality 
product, and service quality reputation in most key cities in mainland China. We forecast 
its market share will reach 30% in 2026E and expect AirTAC to be the structural winner 
in a deflationary market, due to its: (1) strong market growth and leadership: AirTAC 
continues to expand its market share in mainland China driven by competitive pricing 
that is more than 10% lower vs. international peers (with 45%+ GM / 30-35% OPM) and 
high demand elasticity among mainland China customers; and (2) superior cost structure 
and financial health: with best-in-class cash cost and a solid balance sheet, featuring 
positive net cash over FCF since 2023/2024, we believe AirTAC is well-equipped to 
weather industry downturns and capitalize on market restructuring. 
Overall, we believe AirTAC will see better revenue/profitability in the long term given its 
share gainer position in the China pneumatic market and potential to gain share in the 
linear guide market (improved demand in the next 1-2 years). This should lead to 
strengthened valuation, vs. its recent trading range (trading below its 10-year avg. P/E 
multiple). We are Buy rated on AirTAC. 
Price target risks and methodology - AirTAC 
Valuation methodology: Our 12m TP of NT$1,925 is based on a target P/E of 26.0x on 
our 2027E EPS (0.25x STDV above avg of the last pneumatic upcycle). 
Key downside risks: (1) Stronger competition from peers; (2) sharper-than-expected 
Rmb depreciation, and (3) a longer-than-expected end-market demand downtrend in 
mainland China.

M
Update
AirTAC International  | Asia Pacific
July Sales +2% MoM/+51% YoY
Here we focus on AirTAC's monthly sales, which we believe
could be a catalyst for its share price.
What's new:
• July sales came in at NT$3,994mn (+2% MoM/+51% YoY),
• By segment, shipments from battery (+65% YoY), machine tool (+40% YoY),
general machinery (+33% YoY), Electronics (+33% YoY), and textiles (+31%
YoY) outperformed during the month.
• QTD revenue reached 34% of MSe at NT$11,586mn (-5% QoQ/+41% YoY)

and 36% of consensus at NT$11,105mn (-9% QoQ/+35% YoY).
Outlook:
• We see 3Q26 sales tracking in line with our estimate, but slightly ahead of
the consensus.
• Both orders and shipments are above its internal target, supported by the
industry upcycle, its own share gains, and the government stimulus policies.
• Management remains positive on the growth outlook for 2026 and expects
the upcycle to extend into 2027.
• Stay OW, as current valuation of 21x 2027e P/E seems undemanding vs. its

mid-cycle average of 25x.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
AirTAC International (1590.TW)
Base case, 29x 2027e P/E. We believe this methodology better captures earnings growth
momentum for industrial automation component plays (market sentiment moves along
with business cycles). As the industry enters an up-cycle, we think applying a near-peak cycle
valuation of 29x P/E is reasonable given the stronger business outlook.
Risks to Upside
n Stronger macroeconomic climate in China

n Stronger-than-expected demand from industrial automation
Risks to Downside
n Sharper economic downturn in China
n Miniature linear guideway business development taking more time
n Larger-than-expected investment in new products but weaker-than-expected demand

### Page 1

M
Update
Vanguard International Semiconductor  | Asia
Pacific
Strong demand but limited by
supply constraint; reiterate EW
Price hikes in 2027 should be larger than in 2026 with tighter supply/demand
dynamics: Management expects  supply to be tighter in 2027 than in 2026, driven by
AI, industrial demand recovery, and share gain in the consumer sector. 2027 pricing
will reflect incremental production cost and depreciation from capacity expansion,
with a larger adjustment than in 2026. The company continues to invest in both 8-

and 12-inch capacity to meet the strong demand.
3Q26 guidance lower than peer's given supply constraint: Management guided for
3Q26 wafer shipments up only 1-3% Q/Q owing to bottlenecks from a few tools, vs.
UMC’s high-single-digit Q/Q rise. However, Vanguard continues to lift wafer ASP by
hiking prices and  optimizing product  mix, driving a 2-4% Q/Q ASP rise.
No concrete plan for Singapore fab phase 2 yet: Singapore fab phase 1's  break-even
point and ramp are  ahead of schedule, and its 44kwpm capacity is fully booked.

However, the company currently doesn’t have a concrete plan for phase 2 capacity
expansion. It would like to focus on phase 1 ramp and execution.

Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-08-05
Pages: 7
Status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Industrials

What’s new: Eternal announced its 2Q26 results after market hours.

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results beat. 2Q26 revenue reached 
TWD472.5m, up 13% QoQ and 32% YoY, broadly in line with consensus. 
The gross margin came in at 43.4%, exceeding our forecast and 
consensus by 2.9pp and 2.7pp, respectively, mainly on improved capacity 
utilisation. Without the one-off employee stock option expense in 1Q26, 
2Q26 operating profit beat our forecast and consensus by 15% and 31%, 
respectively. Supported by a lower tax rate, EPS was TWD0.67, exceeding 
our forecast and consensus by 29% and 37%, respectively.

ABF expansion trend remains intact. In line with customers’ shipment 
schedules, management has guided for sequential monthly revenue growth 
throughout 3Q26. We forecast 3Q26 revenue to increase by 30% QoQ to 
TWD615.2m. With high-end products gradually ramping up, we expect the 
gross margin to expand by 2pp QoQ to 45.4%. The sharp increase in 
backlog provides a clear leading indicator of accelerating growth ahead. 
Eternal’s order backlog as of end-July increased by >180% from TWD286m 
at end-1Q26. Continued upward revisions of ABF capex among substrate 
manufacturers should provide further support to its order momentum: 1) 
Unimicron (3037 TT, TWD969, Buy [1]; covered by Sheng Cheng) raised its 
2026 capex budget by 58%, primarily to expand ABF capacity; 2) Kinsus 
(3189 TT, TWD828, Buy [1]; covered by Sheng Cheng) announced 
additional capex and introduced a customer co-investment mechanism 
through equipment subsidies; 3) ZDT (4958 TT, Not rated) is aggressively 
expanding its Shenzhen capacity; and 4) SEMCO (009150 KS, 
KRW1,356,000, Buy [1]; covered by SK Kim) announced a KRW8tn 
investment plan through 2040 for its AI server package substrate business. 
To meet robust demand, Eternal plans to increase capacity at its Japan 
plant from 18 to 25 units by mid-2027. It also plans to double capacity at its 
China plant to ease the Japan plant’s capacity bottleneck by taking over 
production of low/mid-range products. We expect this capacity reallocation 
to provide further upside to Eternal’s product mix and profitability.

What we recommend: We reaffirm our Buy (1) rating and maintain our 12-
month TP of TWD600 based on an unchanged target PER of 40x, applied 
to our 1-year forward EPS forecast. As a key beneficiary of the ongoing 
ABF capacity expansion cycle, we believe the recent global technology 
stock pullback presents an attractive entry point for Eternal. Key downside 
risk: slower-than-expected substrate capex growth.

How we differ: We likely conduct a more comprehensive analysis than 
others on ABF industry demand.

5 August 2026

2Q26 results review: earnings acceleration ahead

➢ 2Q26 GM beat while mix upgrade yet to unfold 
➢ Continued ABF capex upgrades underpin a clear growth trajectory 
➢ Reaffirming Buy (1) rating with unchanged 12M TP of TWD600

manufacturers worldwide.

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: Following our results memo, we raise our forecasts, TP and 
upgrade our rating on Global Unichip (GUC) by 2 notches to Buy (1), 
thanks to: 1) more capacity unleashed from its key foundry to meet more 
demand for higher top-line; and 2) more frugal opex control to help offset 
the extra demand, which is AI-centric and volume-accretive but gross 
margin (GM) dilutive. Our forecast hikes, together with the recent share 
price correction on equity market’s hefty expectation reset for “silicon 
inflation”, in our view, offer an attractive opportunity for bargain hunting.

What’s the impact: Forecast revisions. We raise our 2026-28E EPS by 
9-19% for GUC to factor in mixed business drivers. On the positive front, 
revenue run rate appears to be running across its Turnkey (ie. mass-
production) and NRE businesses, thanks to customers’ active datacentre 
buildout driven by migration from generative to agentic AI. Based on our 
market research, for the Turnkey business, we now forecast revenue to 
more than double YoY this year to TWD54bn for 85% contribution, driven 
by extra capacity unleashed by its key foundry partner, helping GUC meet 
more customer demand across AI CPU and accelerators, current and next 
generations. For NRE, albeit some rebalancing in 3Q26 following a strong 
uptick a quarter ago, we expect revenue to recover in 4Q26 for meaningful 
ramps into 2027, driven by new AI projects and AI automotive ship-outs.

Strong top-line and frugal opex … GUC’s AI projects are volume 
accretive but GM dilutive, since the higher value-add parts such as core 
dies are not done by GUC, which focuses on advanced packaging. That 
said, by leveraging its integrated “ADS+APT” model (advanced design 
service, advanced packaging tech), with strategic capacity support from its 
key foundry, we see scope for GUC to move up the GM vertical.

… helping mitigate lower GM. Another positive factor is, since GUC does 
not need to commit much R&D relative to projects prior to AI, opex should 
remain well controlled. While we forecast its GM trajectory to shift into the 
low 20s over our forecast period (vs. c.30% on average in the past decade 
before the AI ramp), we expect its operating margin to improve to 14-15% 
over our forecast period (vs. 7-15% on an annual basis over 2016-25).

What we recommend: We raise our 12M TP to TWD5,125 (previous: 
TWD4,525), based on a new 4-quarter forward PER of 63x (previous: 75x), 
justified by 2025-28E EPS CAGR of 60%. We hike our rating 2 notches to 
Buy (1), with downside risk of less foundry support and margin execution.

How we differ: Our 2026E EPS is 12% above consensus, likely on our 
higher AI CPU and accelerator business assumptions.

5 August 2026

Upgrading: unleashed capacity adding to growth

➢ Raise our forecasts on increased capacity support and frugal opex 
➢ AI projects are gross-margin dilutive but scale accretive 
➢ Upgrade rating to Buy (1), with a higher 12M TP of TWD5,125

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.
Benchmarks for each region are as follows: North America - S&P 500; Latin America - relevant MSCI country index or MSCI Latin America Index; Europe - MSCI Europe; Japan - TOPIX; Asia -

Novatek
Company description
Novatek Microelectronics Corp., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and markets
integrated circuits (ICs). The company's products are used in
telecommunication, computer peripherals, consumer electronics, and LCD
(liquid crystal display) drivers.
Investment strategy
We rate Novatek shares as Neutral. 2026 headwinds mainly came from rising
memory costs and inflation (eg, OSATs), pressuring its GM profile. Although

rising costs are negatively impacting end demand, we believe downside is
likely limited given lean inventory levels both in Novatek itself and customers.
Looking forward, we do expect Novatek to see good progress in 2026 in OLED
DDIC for both the Android camp and iPhone camp with potential market
share gain. However, considering lack of catalysts in sight in 2H26, we believe
its share price would be range bound in the near term. A high dividend yield of

c.5% would provide some protection to the shares, in our view.
Valuation
Our target price of NT$555 is based on a 15x 2027E PE, which is higher than
the average level of its 1-year forward consensus PE average of 13x over the
past five years, justified by lean inventory levels in the industry, better S/D in
the TV market, likely better progress in AMOLED DDIC for Apple business
starting in 2026 (higher-than-expected market share) and ASIC upside. Our

target price is equivalent to 2026/27E PB of 4.5x/4.2x.
Risks
Key upside risks that could cause the stock to trade above our target price
include: 1) less macro uncertainty and recovering consumer demand; 2) fast
edge AI ramp and resolution migration; 3) SoC business growth faster than
expected; and 4) less increase in gold prices. Key downside risks include: 1)
foundry hike pressure along with muted end demand; 2) foundry capacity
constraints for certain nodes to limit growth potential; 3) edge AI ramp and

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

Summary: Accton released its results after market hours on 6 August, with net income of 
TWD11.05bn (EPS: TWD19.70), beating our and street consensus by 6%/5%, respectively. 
2Q26 sales (TWD95.5bn; up 36% QoQ and 58% YoY) was 10-12% higher than the street’s 
expectation due mainly to strength from new generation ASIC AI card ramp from June. 
Another key highlight is that gross and operating margins also improved QoQ in 2Q26 due 
mainly to better operating leverage and resilient Meta 800G switch demand. Looking 
ahead, we still expect a decent QoQ growth in 3Q26 due to on-going new generation ASIC 
AI card ramp. However, we learned from our channel checks with the supply chain that key 
end customers lack key components (eg, memory) and are slowing down orders in 3Q26. 
However, we believe it’s just a short-term hiccup and we remain positive on Accton to ride 
on better-than-expected ASIC AI server demand from 2H26, which tallies with our previous 
note (link here).  We reaffirm our Buy (1) call and 12-month TP of TWD3,666, based on an 
unchanged target PER of 35x applied to our 1-year-forward EPS forecast. Downside risk: 
worse-than-expected ASIC server and switch demand.

What’s the impact: 
Below are our read-throughs from Accton’s 2Q26 results (released on 6 August).

• 2Q26 results first-take: results beat on pull-in demand. Accton released its results 
after market hours on 6 August, with net income of TWD11.05bn (EPS: TWD19.70), 
beating our estimate and street consensus by 6%/5%, respectively. 2Q26 sales 
(TWD95.5bn; up 36% QoQ and 58% YoY) was 10-12% higher than the street’s 
expectation due mainly to strength from new generation ASIC AI card ramp from June. 
Despite the rising contribution from ASIC AI servers (lower than blended gross margin), 
Accton still improved its gross margin by 0.2pp to 19.7% given the resilient contribution 
from Meta’s 800G switches. As such, operating margin expanded 0.7pp to 15% due to 
better operating leverage and gross margin expansion. However, net profit was dragged 
by a higher tax rate of 24.2% in 2Q26 (vs. 19.6% in 1Q26).

• Business outlook. Accton also announced July monthly revenue of TWD39.5bn 
(flattish % MoM but up 72% YoY), which achieved 37% of our 3Q26 revenue forecast 
(TWD106.9bn; up 12% QoQ and 47% YoY) and 37% of Bloomberg consensus 
(TWD106.8bn). We consider the progress to be tracking ahead of expectations, as July 
sales typically account for 30-33% of its 3Q sales. Despite the run-rate already ahead of 
expectations, we believe Accton’s performance could be even better, as its key AI card 
customer has slowed down its order placing due to its component shortage (likely from 
memory). As such, the AI card demand in 3Q26 could be even stronger than what we

Date: 2026-08-06
Pages: 7
Status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: Novatek disclosed upbeat 2Q26 results and 3Q26 guidance 
thanks to continued supply-chain cost pass-through, as well as share gain 
in the high-end smartphone OLED display driver (D/D) market. Though we 
raise forecasts and TP to reflect these unusual business dynamics amid 
the “silicon inflation”, we remain comfortable with our Hold (3) rating. That 
said, we are structurally positive on its leading position in design and 
technology for SoC diversification to cope with the D/D competition.

What’s the impact: Results and guidance all beat yet ... Novatek 
reported 2Q26 EPS of TWD10.4, beating our/consensus estimates by 
31%/36% thanks to robust gross margin (GM) that beat guidance (38-41%) 
and market expectation on supply-chain cost pass-through, favourable SoC 
mix and low-cost inventory, as well as frugal opex control and higher non-
operating gains associated with investment and dividend incomes (table on 
p.2). Guidance calls for 3Q26 revenue to still grow 5-9% QoQ regardless of 
a demand slowdown in the consumer space. Yet guided GM of 38.5-41.5% 
implies a QoQ drop due to no more low-cost inventory and an unfavourable 
mix as small-and-medium D/D will drive the growth, while SoC revenue will 
be flat and large D/D will drop QoQ, per management.

… business dynamics don’t seem to be structural. While our view 
calling for a demand rebalancing across TV and PC in the consumer space 
after customers’ order pull-in in 1H26 appears to be materialising, per 
management’s comments at today’s call, Novatek’s share gain in the high-
end smartphone OLED D/D market looks to be helping it offset the impact, 
with extra delta to be contributed by the continued pass-through of wafer 
and OSAT cost hikes through the supply chain. We therefore lift our 2026-
28E EPS by 2-21% but view these dynamics as unusual amid the “silicon 
inflation” environment. That said, we remain structurally positive on 
Novatek’s leading position in design capability and process technology for 
diversification into a broadened SoC portfolio to cope with any intense D/D 
competition, including machine-vision solutions for applications from 
surveillance to drones, smart wearables, smart appliances to robotics.

What we recommend: Given our forecast revisions, we raise our 12M TP 
for Novatek to TWD515 (previous: TWD430), still based on our 4-quarter 
forward PER target of 13x. We reaffirm our Hold (3) rating with key 
upside/downside risks of any further cost pass-through/deteriorated end-
demand on commodity price hikes.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 20-24% above the consensus, as 
we believe the street has yet to factor in the full effect of the cost pass-
through.

6 August 2026

Rebalancing still yet resilience on share gain

➢ 2Q26 results and 3Q26 guidance all upbeat  
➢ Consumer rebalancing offset by high-end smartphone share gain 
➢ Reiterating Hold (3) rating with a higher 12M TP of TWD515

2Q26 result overview 
NYPCB 2Q26 core business (OPI) was 15% higher than BBG 
consensus, but was 8% lower than our estimate (most bullish on the 
street). GM went up by 8.9ppt QoQ, the highest growth among all 
Taiwan ABF players (Unimicron/Kinsus’ GM went up by 
+6.8ppt/+4.9ppt QoQ only in 2Q26), which is in-line with our more 
bullish view on spot price ABF substrates players’ profitability 
expansion speed vs. LTA players. For earnings, NYPCB’s 2Q EPS was 
5% higher than the BBG consensus but was 18% lower than GSe.  
3Q26 outlook - UTR in Kunshan start ramping up despite low yield 
rate, while ABF/BT pricing hike will continue to drive GM/OPM 
For 3Q26, we expect NYPCB’s revenue will go up by 27% QoQ in 
3Q26, while the key update is the company’s Kunshan plant 
(~15-20% of overall ABF substrate capacity) utilization rate reached 
70% in July (vs. 50% in 2Q26; which drove July revenue went up by 
16% MoM), with key high end customers starting to place orders in 
mainland China (which is in-line with our view that all the ABF 
substrates capacity will be working under fully utilized level from 
2H26, due to the severe shortage condition of ~15-20% shortage 
ratio; see here). 
However, our understanding is that the company’s Kunshan plant 
was built for mid to low end ABF substrates, and the increasing 
production on high-end ABF substrate in Kunshan plant could lead 
to an unfavorable GM for overall ABF substrates business in the near 
term (3Q26), but we do expect this will be offset by the increasing 
spot price from August/September, and we also believe the yield 
rate will eventually improve and lead to an even higher than 
company’s average GM in coming months/quarters. As a result, we 
expect NYPCB’s 3Q GM will further jump by 6.6ppt QoQ to 
31.3%, whose GM could surpass Kinsus/Unimicron and become

Investment thesis - GM to surpass TW peers from 2H26; new CAPEX on high end ABF 
substrates suggesting more upside on ASP in LT 
As discussed several times (see here), we believe NYPCB will start outgrowing players on 
the margin side from 2H26, when the ABF substrate market enters a real supply 
shortage stage, and we saw NYPCB’s GM approaching Kinsus/Unimicron’s in 2Q26, who 
should start delivering a stronger GM from 2H26, as we discussed, due mainly to the 
company’s proactive strategy on pricing (focus on spot price market should make the 
company deliver a better GM/OPM outlook than LTA peers during the shortage period). 
Considering our positive view on the ABF substrate demand and the long capacity 
expansion lead time of the industry, we believe the ABF substrate capacity shortage 
period will last for 30+ months, implying NYPCB’s outperformance on GM/OPM growth 
vs. other TW ABF names should not be just a short-term condition.  
Moreover, the company announced a new CAPEX plan (here), while the company will 
invest in NT$46.8bn (vs. the company’s overall CAPEX in 2025 was only at NT$2.4bn vs. 
peak annual CAPEX in last upcycle was NT$16.9bn only) on a new high-end ABF 
substrate plant in Chiayi. Based on our estimate, the new capacity will be used to 
produce TSMC next generation CoPoS packaging substrates, and the capacity could 
come on stream right after TSMC start mass producing CoPoS packaging technology in 
2H28-1H29 (the capacity expansion lead time is also in-line with our view of 30+ 
months). We do believe the company’s proactive investment in the next generation 
packaging technology should lead the company’s overall ASP to another level, while we 
believe the substrate size / layer count could be 100%/ 30%+ larger/higher than the 
company’s most high end products now, suggesting a long term revenue/earnings 
outlook after 2028.  
Overall, considering the near term profitability outperformance and the positive 
long term revenue/earning outlook with the new high-end capacity expansion, we 
maintain our Buy rating (on CL) on NYPCB with new TP of NT$2,500 (from 
NT$2,310).

Earnings revision 
We revise up our 2027/28/29E earnings estimate by 2/9/23% to factor in the more

Valuation

unchanged 21x 2028E EPS (+1.5x STDV above the past upcycle average P/E of 13.3x as 
we expect a better pricing outlook in spot price market this time vs. last upcycle in 
2020-2022), considering the much better customer mix and the much better demand 
visibility.

(70%+ of total revenue), where we expect GM/OPM to increase significantly in the

expanding high-end exposure will lead to a long term earnings growth outlook (122%

earnings and stock performance.

M
Idea
3Q26 revenue to stay strong but GM remains suppressed: Management expected
revenue to continue to grow both QoQ and YoY, with GM and OPM roughly flat
QoQ (37.7% and 19.6% in 2Q26) as component costs remain elevated. By region, it
guides for North America to grow in double digits (%) QoQ and YoY, Europe to grow
in single digits QoQ and double digits YoY, and China to be flat QoQ and up in
double digits YoY. Book-to-bill (B/B) ratio  was 1.44 in 2Q26, with NA, Europe, and

China at 1.92, 1.25, and 1.21, respectively. It rose further to 1.64 in July, presaging
continued strength in coming quarters. Meanwhile, design wins have been solid YTD,
e.g. around US$650mn (+250% YoY) for 125 projects   (+43% YoY) in North America
(on track to reach US$900mn+ for 2026) and US$70-80mn in Europe, forming a
decent backlog for future growth.
Component supply lead time lengthening: Management indicates  much longer
component lead time at 8-12 months  recently vs. the prior 6-8 months. Despite the

tight supply of several key components (PCB, SSD, CPUs, power ICs, etc.), it has
secured most of  the volume for its shipments in 2H26. It also plans another wave of
selling price hikes in 2H26, probably in double digits (%), to pass the incremental
costs  on to its customers.
Edge AI –  big opportunities: Advantech focuses on edge/physical AI for AI
infrastructure and other verticals, such as manufacturing, medical, retail, energy,
robotics, etc. On top of the hardware offerings, it also has the aspiration to have

hardware/software integrated solutions (IWS: Integrated WISE Solution and
Station). Edge AI accounted for  22.5% of its revenue in 1H26 and could be more than
30% for 2026 (vs. 15% in 2025)
Stay OW; price target lifted to NT$720 (30x 2027e P/E, implying a PEG of 1.0):
We maintain the view that Advantech is well positioned to benefit from accelerating
IoT market growth amid edge AI proliferation.

Advantech: Valuation Methodology
Price target of NT$720 (previously NT$400): This is our base case value, based on a
target P/E multiple of 30x applied to our 2027 EPS estimate (30x 2025e P/E previously).
We view our target multiple as justifiable by our 30% earnings CAGR forecast for 2025-28
vs.  the stock's average one-year forward P/E of 25x in 2015-22 and the earnings CAGR of
8% during that period.
Bull case scenario value – NT$950 (previously NT$500): We apply a 40x P/E multiple

to our earnings estimate for 2027 (37x 2025e P/E previously). This scenario mainly reflects
more top- and bottom-line growth from the platform and applications by leveraging the
solid base in IoT edge layer devices.
Bear case scenario value – NT$380 (previously NT$215): We apply a 16x P/E multiple to
our earnings estimate for 2027 (16x 2025e P/E previously). This scenario factors in slower
progress in the edge AI implementation, which could lead to weaker revenue and earnings

growth. The macro environment could also cast some uncertainty on the stock's outlook.

Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

### Page 1

M
Update
Hiwin Technologies Corp.  | Asia Pacific
July Sales Rose 5% MoM, 34%
YoY
In this report, we focus on Hiwin's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for its share price.
Details:
• July sales were NT$2,682mn (+5% MoM/+34% YoY).
• QTD revenue was 33% of our 3Q26 estimate at NT$8,018mn (+7% QoQ/
+34% YoY) and 35% of consensus at NT$7,746mn (+3% QoQ/+29% YoY).
Our view:
• We think 3Q26 is tracking largely in line with expectations.

• Riding on the industry recovery trend, we think Hiwin should see good
revenue momentum in the coming quarters and could deliver margin
expansion from 2H26 on higher utilization and price hikes.
• We stay constructive on the stock, with current valuation at 34x 2027e P/E
vs. a peak cycle level of 35-40x.
• The company is scheduled to release its 2Q26 results on 12 Aug after the
market close.

Morgan Stanley Research 3
Valuation Methodology and Risks
Hiwin Technologies Corp. (2049.TW)
Base case, P/E. We think this valuation methodology better captures Hiwin's earnings growth
momentum, as its valuation tends to move with the business cycle. We apply a target multiple
of 37x to our 2027 EPS estimate. We view this multiple as justified by the 44% operating profit
CAGR we project for 2025-28.
Risks to Upside
n Stronger industrial automation demand pickup.

n Market share gains.
n Earlier-than-expected revenue contribution from humanoids.
Risks to Downside
n Weaker industrial automation demand.
n More pricing pressure.
n Market share loss.
n More broad-based impact on the global economy from geopolitical risks.

WinWay Technology Co Ltd  | Asia Pacific
Revising Full-year Revenue, But
Tempering GM Expectations
2Q26 earnings came in higher than MSe:
• EPS was NT$18.8, -2% Q/Q and +229% Y/Y; 15% above MSe but 6% below
Street.
• Revenue was +18% Q/Q and +131% Y/Y
° Coaxial socket +27% Q/Q; beyond ongoing Rubin, Venice, and Axion
shipments, Winway also began shipping AI5 and NVIDIA LPU sockets in
2Q.
° MEMS probe card sales +47% Q/Q, mainly for Vera CPU and connectivity

products.
• GM fell 4.7ppt to 38.3%, 0.5ppt above MSe but 3.4ppt below Street,
reflecting higher MEMS revenue and fixed-cost increases from new-capacity
ramp.
3Q outlook
• July revenue was +10% M/M and +156% Y/Y, as Winway continues to fulfill
the backlog.
• Management expects 3Q revenue to be up at least 35% Q/Q, above MSe
(+25–30% Q/Q) and Street (+10% Q/Q).
• However, with rising MEMS exposure and fixed costs, GM is likely 38–40%
vs. Street 44%. Management expects sequential margin recovery into 2027,

WinWay Technology Co Ltd (6515.TW)

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

shipments. Management expects 2H to be stronger than 1H and data center to
continue its strong growth in 2027. 3Q EPS is guided at NT$7.55-8.52; the mid-point
is 41%/26% higher than MSe/consensus; the outlook suggests continued benefits

from operating leverage and a more favorable business mix.
2Q26 earnings beat on AI-driven scale and operating leverage: 2Q26  revenue
reached NT$591bn (+20% QoQ, +128% YoY), operating margin expanded to 2.20%
despite gross margin edging down slightly  to 3.41%; EPS was NT$7.68 (+44% QoQ,
+237% YoY), 3%/21% higher than MSe/consensus. By segment, datacenter & server
remained the key growth engine, accounting for 59% of revenue and posting 24%
QoQ / 274% YoY growth.

Maintain OW: WT Micro continues to gain share in AI infrastructure while
maintaining disciplined cost control; the stock trades at 8.3x  2027e EPS, below it
8.9x average one-year forward P/E since 2018; we view the valuation as attractive,
given the company's continued progress in penetrating the AI supply chain.

### Page 1

ab 6 August 2026
Global Research
Advantech
Sustained robust order growth
Better-than-expected Q326 guidance
Advantech hosted an analyst meeting on 5 Aug and issued Q326 guidance
better than market expected  in terms of higher revenue QoQ. Order momentum
remains strong: the book-to-bill (BB) ratio remained   >1 and design win project value (a
leading indicator of the order backlog) was up 180% QoQ. Management  has  signed an
LTA to secure memory supply while highlighting PCB supply tightness in Q426. Rising

costs (mainly memory and CPU) may be largely passed on to prices. Advantech also
highlighted new opportunities of expanding into a hardware/software (WEDA + WISE)
one-stop automation solution in international markets in one to two years. We remain
positive on Advantech's earnings growth trajectory and maintain our Buy rating.
Management confident about sustainable above-trend growth
In Q226, total revenue  increased 46% YoY. By project type, edge AI projects accounted

for c24% and recorded growth of 108% YoY, up from 61% YoY in Q126. Non-AI
projects also recorded robust growth of 34% YoY. Management highlighted  customers
are anxious about deploying automation later than competitors, which is the major
cause for strong order placement.  The BB ratio fell to 1.44 in Q226, from 1.77 in Q126,
but trended up to 1.64 in July. Design win project value increased to US$444m in Q226
from US$158m in Q126. For Q326, management plans to add capacities by 5-10% or

more through higher utilization and adding outsourcing capacities. By market,
management is bullish about revenue up double digits QoQ for the US, Japan and
Taiwan, up single digits QoQ for Europe and flattish for China. By end applications, AI
cloud infrastructure, semi equipment, factory automation, robotics, medical and energy
have been major order drivers. Management highlighted the project lead time is
lengthening, with AI infrastructure and semi equipment orders confirmed until 2027.

Higher input costs to be largely  passed on
Advantech's Q226 gross margin declined QoQ, as it charged a much lower than
corporate average margin for additional input costs.  Besides memory, Advantech plans
to pass on recently rising CPU costs in Q3-Q426.  Regarding key component sourcing,
management is more confident about delivery in Q326, while noting possible specialty
PCB tightness in Q426. Management is mitigating sourcing risks by signing long-term

agreements and qualifying a more diverse supplier base.
Valuation: Raise PT to NT$744; reiterate Buy
We raise our 2026-28E earnings 6-8%, mainly on lower opex/sales on scale benefits.
Our earnings estimates are above consensus by 10-15%. We maintain our Buy rating
and lift  our PT to  NT$744 (30x 2027E PE) from NT$628 (27x 2027E PE). That is not
stretched, at +0.8 SD, with 2027E earnings growth also stronger, at 24% (+1.1 SD).

Advantech UBS Research
Thesis Map     UBS                    Research     THESIS MAP a guide to our thinking and what´s where in this report
Q: How can AI technologies accelerate investment into automation?
We think automation investment growth could accelerate as AI technology advances control systems
and agentic AI transforms automation into autonomous manufacturing, further improving
production efficiency. Moreover, edge-AI is expanding automation applications beyond factories and

into industries requiring high levels of data privacy.
Q: Which supply chain subsectors benefit from higher automation investment?
Market research agencies forecast the smart manufacturing (software & hardware) and robot
industries to see sales growth  of 14-20% during 2025-32F, notably faster than industrial machinery
at 7-9%. Among smart manufacturing, these market forecasters expect all three segments (software,
hardware and services) to maintain a 15% sales CAGR during 2025-32F, with hardware slightly

accelerating from a 14% sales CAGR during 2022-24.
Q: How fast will humanoid robots scale up?
We estimate humanoid robots ( link, link) to ramp up to a global population of more than 2m by
2035E and more than 300m by 2050E, implying TAM of US$30-40bn in 2035E and US$1.4-1.7trn by
2050E, for an ecosystem spanning components and OEMs, software and data, production and
services.
We think Advantech looks well positioned to benefit from: 1) accelerating investment in automation

as a hardware supplier for multinational industrial automation providers, 2) dedicated teams to
provide customised automation solutions, and 3) the expansion into AI-powered projects. We
forecast Advantech's earnings growth to accelerate via strong order intake and operating margin
expansion from scale benefits.
The BB ratio fell to 1.44 in Q226, from 1.77 in Q126, but trended up to 1.64 in July. Design win
project value, a leading indicator of the order backlog, increased 180% QoQ to US$444m in Q226

from US$158m in Q126. Advantech also registered accelerated sales growth of 46.5% in Q226, with
edge AI projects accounting for c24% and recording growth of 108% YoY, up from 61% YoY in
Q126. Non-AI projects recorded robust growth of 34% YoY.
Advantech is now trading at 25x 2027E PE, in line with 5-year average while its earnings grow during
2026-27 is 1.1-3.8 SD above historical average. We expect consensus earnings upward revisions and
solid monthly sales growth to serve as positive share price catalysts.

Established in 1981 and listed on the Taiex in 1999, Advantech is a world-leading Taiwanese IPC
(industrial PC) supplier. Its product offerings involve embedded boards and chassis, industrial
computers and controls, and after-sales services with applications spanning manufacturing

automation, healthcare, transportation, energy and networking industries. To serve global markets, it
has three manufacturing sites in Taiwan, Japan and China and direct subsidiaries in 27 countries.

Company Description
Established in 1981 and listed on the Taiex in 1999, Advantech is a world-leading Taiwanese
IPC supplier. Its product offerings involve embedded boards and chassis, industrial computers
and controls, and after-sales services with applications spanning manufacturing automation,

healthcare, transportation, energy and networking industries. To serve the global market, it
has three manufacturing sites in Taiwan, Japan and China and direct subsidiaries in 27
countries.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We base our price target for Advantech on 30x 2027E PE.
Industrial PC sector risks include: slower global economic growth; uncertain trade tariff
negotiations; higher interest rates that could result in weaker capex investment; readiness

and supply chain bottlenecks of IT technology could slow project execution; currency
movement; and changes in component pricing that could bring downside to profitability.
In our view, key company-specific risks include: 1) slower-than-expected edge-AI product
adoption; 2) competition in the non-AI IPC segment, especially in China; 3) rising component
prices; 4) NTD appreciation against the USD; 5) slower macroeconomic growth that could
negatively impact overall capex allocation; and 6) demand growth that could attract more

new suppliers to join the market, which may intensify competition and possibly bring price
pressure.

Industry View In-Line
Our CY26 full-year forecast is now at 80-85K racks: This bakes in our recently
raised ~3.8K rack-equivalent forecast at Wistron (report here), to ~17.9K racks. This

year is a strong one for downstream rack assembly. We expect over 100% y/y
growth in rack shipments, vs. ~29k last year.
Quanta (2382.TW, OW): July revenue was NT$366.3B (-5% m/m, +131% y/y). We
attribute the m/m decline mainly to lower NB shipments, at 2.8M units (-38% m/m).
As for GB200/300 rack shipments in the month, we estimate Quanta delivered 2.2-
2.25K racks (-4% m/m) in July. Our full-year assumption is unchanged, at ~18.7K
racks.
Wistron (3231.TW, OW): July revenue was  NT$308.2B (-4% m/m, +61% y/y). We

attribute the m/m decline to: 1) lower NB shipment, at 1.6M units (-20% m/m); 2)
lower DT shipments, at 700K units (-13% m/m); 3) lower monitor shipments, at
900K units (-10% m/m); and 4) slightly lower GB200/300 server computing tray
shipments (1,150-1,200 rack equivalents, by our estimates, down 6% m/m), offset by
higher Wiwynn revenue, at NT$117.7B (+6% m/m, +39% y/y). Our full-year forecast
was raised to ~17.9K racks recently.
Hon Hai (2317.TW, OW): July revenue was NT$946.5B (+15% m/m, +54% y/y), with

all segments growing m/m, with server-related revenue seeing the strongest m/m
growth, followed by computing products, followed by components and other
products, and lastly the consumer segment, which mainly includes iPhone assembly.
We model HH's GB rack shipments at 3.6K racks (+9% m/m). Our full-year forecast
is unchanged, at ~31.7K racks.

which:
Quanta shipped 2.2-2.25K  GB200/GB300 racks.
Wistron shipped 1.1-1.2K GB200/GB300 racks.
Hon Hai shipped ~3.6K GB200/300 racks.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Hon Hai Precision (2317.TW)
Base case scenario value, derived from a residual income valuation model. Our key assump-
tions include a cost of equity of 8.5%, a medium-term growth rate of 13%, and a terminal
growth rate of 3%.
Risks to Upside
n Better-than-expected iPhone sell-through
n Faster progress in AI server business
n Faster EV business development progress
n Any new M&A activity that could improve sentiment

Risks to Downside
n Lower iPhone sell-through
n Smaller profit contribution from AI business
n Slower EV business development progress
n Geopolitical developments that could negatively affect foreign investment
Quanta Computer Inc. (2382.TW)
Base case, residual income model. Key assumptions include a cost of equity of 9.0% (beta of
1.2, equity premium of 6.0% and risk-free rate of 1.5%), an 8.5% medium-term growth rate, and
a 3% terminal growth rate.

Risks to Upside
n Stronger-than-expected NB demand
n Stronger-than-expected Apple Watch demand
n Stronger-than-expected server demand
n Faster-than-expected AI server penetration
Risks to Downside
n Weaker-than-expected NB demand
n Softer-than-expected Apple Watch demand
n Weak margin performance owing to rising labor costs and sales shortfalls
n Fierce price competition in the mega data center segment
n Slower-than-expected AI server penetration

Wistron Corporation (3231.TW)

### Page 1

ab 8 August 2026
Global Research
First Read
Giant Manufacturing
Q226 beat on stronger gross margin; positive
sales outlook intact
Q: How did the results compare with expectations?
In Q226, Giant reported net profit up 234% YoY, 126%/28% above the UBS/consensus
estimates. The beat was mainly due to a higher-than-expected gross margin.
Q: What were the most noteworthy areas in the results?
In Q226, sales  rose 6% YoY. Sales in China were up 13% YoY, ending its declining trend

of the past six consecutive quarters. Sales contraction in Europe/US narrowed to
4%/15%. E-bike sales also resumed growth at 20% YoY. Newly launched city e-bikes in
Europe  were well received and drove strong volume growth. Gross margin expanded
4.4ppt YoY on new model launches and a higher portion of own-brand sales (higher
profitability than OEM orders). Opex came in higher than we expected due to marketing
expenses for new product launches, legal fees for its WRO (Withhold  Release Order) and

sports sponsorships (earlier this year vs. in Q3 previously).
Q: Has the company's guidance/outlook changed?
No. Management kept its  2026 top-line guidance unchanged at negative low-
single digits, with the operating margin at 1-3% despite the strong Q226 results.
Management continues to see a positive trend in Europe/China early in Q326 and  initial
signs of a recovery in the US. However, management  is keeping conservative guidance,
considering  macro risks.

Q: How do we expect investors to react?
We think the market is likely to react positively to the results beat.  We raise our
2026E earnings 47% to factor in the Q226 results beat and  better-than-expected
profitability.   We reiterate our Buy rating, based on our positive sector view, and we most
prefer Giant among our covered stocks in this sector. Our price target remains
unchanged at NT$126, based on 17x 2027E PE.

Company Description
Giant Manufacturing (Giant) is the world's largest bicycle manufacturer by volume. It was
established in 1972 and was listed on Taiwan's main board in 1994. Giant focuses on mid- to
high-end bicycle models, with the original brand manufacturing (OBM) business making up

61% of sales and the rest coming from original design manufacturing (ODM) clients as of
Q125.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
Our price target is based on a PE multiple.
The key downside risks are: 1) a global economic slowdown impacting end-user demand; 2)
foreign exchange risk; 3) a rise in raw material prices; 4) unfavourable weather; and 5) lower-
than-expected popularity of e-bike products.

Key observations on HK investors' positioning and interests
The ROIC of AI capex is the most important thing to track for
future hardware demand
For Greater China Semis, our major underlying assumptions for AI semis come from cloud
capex updates ( Exhibit 5 ) and major CSPs' narratives on RoI (Exhibit 2 ). Some HK
investors told us that they are tracking the ARR of LLM vendors, on a quarterly or even
monthly basis, to make sure the revenue expansion is fast enough to cover the growing

capex costs. We alluded to Brian Nowak’s recent research: Internet: The Paths to 25-50%
GenAI ROIC (27 Jul 2026). And from the recent rise in cloud capex budgets, AI revenue
growth, as well as the positive narratives on CSPs' ROIC, we are not worried about
overproduction of AI GPUs and ASICs in 2027 –  our assessment of TSMC CoWoS capacity
implies a 70%-80% Y/Y increase in chip output in 2027.
While spending continues, how big the "memory cake"
should be is a growing debate

Some investors even believe that if memory’s portion of cloud capex budgets shifts to
computing and networking chips, AI capex may generate more computing capacity.  In our
cloud capex 2027 breakdown analysis ( Exhibit 5 ), memory accounts for 53% of the
budget of US$1.5tn, while computing (GPUs, ASICs, CPUs) accounts for 20%.

The implied chip volume vs. electricity consumption (GW)
was frequently asked about, suggesting that power supply
remains a global bottleneck
When we showed our 2027 CoWoS implied chip volume (around 19 mn units), investors
were concerned about whether there would be sufficient electricity.  If each GPU/ASIC's

average TDP is 2kw, it would mean that around 38GW of new electricity would be
needed. Looking at it the other way around, when SpaceX indicated that it would expand
its capacity from 2GW by this year-end, to closer to 10GW as an ambitious target  (see
SpaceX: Strong Beat/Outlook vs. Higher Capex), we were also asked what that means to
TSMC’s CoWoS capacity consumption. Of note, Adam Jonas is only modeling in 3 GW of
incremental computing – getting to 5 GW by year-end 2027. But just in a rough sense, the

additional 8GW would mean around 4mn units of Rubin GPUs or 20% of the AI
accelerators that TSMC produces in 2027. See Exhibit 5  and Exhibit 2  for detailed
analysis.

Memory currently still attracts more attention than logic/

computing semis
HK investors were still more interests in the memory stocks than the logic foundries, such
as TSMC, ASE, and MediaTek. We believe it is because of more positioning with more
volatility in memory stocks. Some investors even stated a belief that “if memory stocks
don’t work, logic foundries like TSMC also can’t work.” Historically, the logic semi and
memory cycles  were indeed concurrent, if they shared the same end demand. However,

we can sense that this time around, there are memory-specific debates. For example, by
sharing the same AI infrastructure, memory is facing more “spec change.” For example, we
were cross-checked about the Rubin Ultra’s HBM spec change and the new Apple iPhone's
DRAM density being reduced from 12GB to 9GB. It seems that investors are trying to

### Page 5

M
Idea
Morgan Stanley Research 5
figure out whether those spec changes have been caused by shortage or customers’ intent
to save costs.
Within memory, we see a split in participation between
momentum and value investors
In our Asian Tech strategist Shawn Kim’s report Asia Technology: Memory – A Small
Wrinkle (6 Aug 2026), he focused on the memory trade vs. valuation support. “The
sharpest correction in the memory industry to date appears to have ended, shifting focus

to buybacks as the next catalyst. ” We do think that momentum investors in HK are more
conservative on the memory stock price rebound – they are focusing on secondary
derivatives (eg. DRAM price Y/Y change), earnings estimate revision breadth, and spot
market trend. For example, when we gave our view about potential price moderation in
Chinese consumer NAND modules into 4Q26, some investors were concerned that it
may affect contract prices in 2027.

However, another camp of memory investors really appreciates the potential cash returns
from memory companies. They are willing to use P/E multiples to evaluate the stocks and
buy on recent dips.
What are key stocks to own, if  investors' focus shifts from
pricing hike to volume play?
We are still bullish on commodity semis such as DRAM/NAND and MLCC. However, some
momentum investors expect  consolidation. Instead, they turned their focus back to

volume plays or  business models, technology that can also add value or increase the
efficiency of AI infrastructure.
Key OWs in logic/compute
• We think TSMC’s wafer business and ASE’s packaging (along with ABF substrates)
are the key concepts of volume plays. Otherwise, we continue to like the ASIC
story (saving on budgets if successfully executed) and keep MediaTek as our Top
Pick.
• We also pushed the agenetic AI enablers CPU proxies in Greater China semis,

including Aspeed (server BMC), Hygon (Chinese CPU), GUC (Google Arm-based
CPU), and ASE (AMD server CPU).
Our calls in niche memories
• Within niche memory, we prefer DDR4 DRAM (OW Nanya Tech and Winbond) to
NAND module makers (EW Phison and Longsys).
Stocks to avoid
• We also suggest avoiding low-end commodity players that may not be able to hike
prices successfully – for example, GWC (EW rated) in raw wafers and Silergy (UW
rated) in consumer analog.

Key analysis: TSMC CoWoS vs. GW consumption
How significant is SpaceX's 8GW data center build in 2027?
During its  earnings call on August 4, SpaceX announced an exclusive commitment to build
its future computing capacity on Nvidia's Vera Rubin architecture. The scale is
unprecedented: 2 gigawatts (GW) of installed computing by 2026, scaling to around 10
GW by 2027.
If realized, this would represent a substantial expansion in SpaceX’s computing footprint

and could support increasingly computing-intensive AI workloads across its businesses.
The buildout would also create another sizable demand vector for NVIDIA accelerators
and the broader AI infrastructure supply chain, including memory, logic wafer supply,
networking, power, etc.
If we assume that all of the 8GW of computing will be Vera Rubin in 2027, it would
suggest around 400k of CoWoS wafer demand, accounting for close to half of Nvidia
Rubin's CoWoS booking in 2027. According to our latest CoWoS forecast, we are expecting

around 38GW of computing power to be produced from TSMC, while SpaceX's 8GW plan
could account for around 20% of total GPU/ASIC production.

Global CSPs kept raising capex during C2Q26 earnings
CSP capex continues to move higher as hyperscalers lean into AI infrastructure buildout
amid sustained demand and ongoing capacity constraints. Recent guidance revisions from
Amazon, Alphabet, and Meta point to a higher-for-longer investment cycle, while
Microsoft’s underlying infrastructure spending remains elevated despite accounting-
related changes in reported capex.
The key investor debate is increasingly shifting from whether AI demand is real to whether

incremental returns can keep pace with the magnitude of capital deployment. For now,
management commentary suggests that confidence remains high, with capacity largely
being absorbed as it comes online, but the rising spending profile raises the bar for future
cloud growth, AI monetization, and free cash flow conversion.
AI investments  are paying off, according to  CSPs' official
comments

### Page 7

Morgan Stanley Research 7
During those CSPs' earnings calls, commentary continued to support the view that rising
AI capex is increasingly underwritten by visible monetization rather than purely
speculative demand. Below are key comments from those CSPs.
Meta: Mark Zuckerberg said “these AI investments are paying off” in the core ads business.
More importantly for the forward ROI debate, he argued that there should be “a
significantly higher margin on selling intelligence rather than selling compute directly. But

think that there's a big opportunity obviously to sell compute as well" and "quite
optimistic to see meaningful growth in all of these areas."
Google: On the capex/ROI question, CFO Anat Ashkenazi said the objective is to “invest as
long as we see an attractive return on that investment.” CEO Pichai added that Alphabet
has become more bullish on the AI opportunity over the past year, citing stronger
consumer, enterprise and developer momentum.
Amazon: Amazon disclosed that AWS's AI revenue run-rate is now above US$25bn and

growing at triple-digit rates YoY, after rising significantly QoQ. Amazon also said that AI
and traditional/core AWS workloads are increasingly reinforcing each other's growth.
Microsoft:- CFO Amy Hood said, “Customer demand continues to exceed available
capacity” and that incremental Azure capacity was “quickly monetized.”

What if memory could  consume less of future cloud capex?
Assuming 2027 global cloud capex from major CSPs reaches US$1.5trn, we expect the mix
to remain heavily skewed toward memory and accelerated‑computing infrastructure,
underscoring the increasingly hardware‑intensive nature of AI investment. Memory
represents the largest component at >50% of total spending in our view, reflecting the
growing importance of HBM and other high‑bandwidth memory technologies with high

ASP driven by severe supply shortage.
GPU/ASIC spending excluding HBM accounts for 15–20%, while infrastructure contributes
20%, highlighting substantial investment in data center buildout, power, cooling, and
networking. Although current server CPU exposure remains relatively low, we believe it
will also enjoy rapid growth in the following years given strong agentic AI demand.
However, the current capex mix is heavily influenced by elevated memory pricing. If

memory prices normalize from current levels, we believe CSPs could reallocate a greater
share of budgets toward GPUs/ASICs and server CPUs, allowing the same overall capex
envelope to support more computing capacity. In this scenario, lower memory costs
could effectively improve the purchasing power of cloud capex and potentially accelerate
deployment of incremental AI computing.

研 究  報 告                
昇達科(3491.TT) 
產業：電子–通信網路 
 3Q26 重回成⻑軌道，太赫茲與高速傳輸方案挹注營收動能 
 投資評價與建議 
看好昇達科受惠低軌衛星部署需求持續成⻑，預估2026/2027年稅後EPS為
19.32/38.76元，過往產業上行期Forward PE區間落在30~50倍，考量昇達科
為衛星微波與毫米波龍頭供應商，從2027年獲利面評價，給予50倍本益比。  
 重點評論分析 
美系客戶更改設計導致出貨遞延，2Q26營收衰退，3Q26營收重回成⻑軌道：
2Q26營收季減11.6%至9.02億元 ， 大幅低於預期 ， 係因美系客戶修改產品設計
導致出貨遞延，毛利率下滑2.38ppts至55.6%，係因產品組合改變，業外收支
增加至1.14億元，係因依照訂單合約規定，修改設計導致半成品和成品無法出
貨，客戶需將其買回，而買回之金額則認列於業外收益，稅後EPS為4.47元。
7月營收月減10.4%至2.3億元，目前公司持續送樣，新產品認證約需6~8週，
最快8月上旬交貨 ， 預估3Q26營收季增17.2%至10.6億元 ， 稅後EPS為4.85元 。  
低軌衛星即將商業運轉，進入星系高速部署期： 展望2026至2027年，營收動
能來自：(1)SpaceX下⼀代衛星V3搭載Ka、E、Q/V與W 4種頻段，頻段增加將
導致衛星內部零組件數量增加，帶動Content Value提升，另外SpaceX自製率
逐步下降加上越南產能完工，昇達科之份額有望持續提升；(2)Amazon LEO規
劃於2029年前部署3,236顆衛星提供完整服務，目前約有2,900顆衛星尚未發
射，另外2027~2028將部署約4,500顆下⼀世代衛星，目前仍在開發中。 
 投資風險 
客戶產品出貨時間遞延、發射計畫進度不如預期。

### Page 2

2

| 營運概況  
美系衛星客戶更改設計導致出貨遞延 ， 2Q26營收衰退 ， 隨新品認證結果出爐開始交貨 ， 3Q26營收重回成⻑軌道 ：
2Q26營收季減11.6%至9.02億元 ， 大幅低於預期 ， 係因美系客戶修改產品設計導致出貨遞延 ， 毛利率下滑2.38ppts
至55.6%，主要原因為低軌衛星高毛利產品出貨減少導致產品組合改變，營業費用2.6億元，業外收支大幅增加至
1.14億元，係因依照訂單合約規定，因修改設計導致舊半成品和成品無法出貨，客戶需將其買回，而買回之補償
金額則認列於業外收益，稅前淨利3.56億元，稅後淨利3.08億元，稅後EPS為4.47元。7月營收仍持續受到出貨遞
延影響，故月減10.4%至2.3億元，營收達成率僅20%，目前公司持續送樣，新產品認證進度約需6~8週，最快8月
上旬公布認證結果後開始交貨，預估3Q26營收季增17.2%至10.6億元，稅後EPS為4.85元。 
低軌衛星即將商業運轉，進入星系高速部署期：展望2026至2027年，營收動能來自：(1)SpaceX下⼀代衛星V3搭
載Ka、E、Q/V與W 4種頻段，頻段增加將導致衛星內部零組件數量增加，帶動Content Value提升，另外未來隨
SpaceX自製率逐步下降加上越南產能完工，昇達科之份額有望持續提升；(2)Amazon LEO規劃於2029年前部署
3,236顆衛星提供完整服務，目前約有2,900顆衛星尚未發射，另外2027~2028將部署約4,500顆下⼀世代衛星，
目前昇達科仍與Amazon合作開發；(3)AST SpaceMobile(ASTS.US)提供手機直連服務，衛星較大顆且內部零 組
件較多，Content Value較兩大美系客戶高，預計 2026年部署60~80顆衛星；(4)Filtronic主要提供毫米波E&W 
Band GaN功率放大器，為SpaceX和歐洲中大型衛星營運商之主要供應商，昇達科則交貨被動元件予Filtronic後
組成module後出貨衛星客戶 ； (5)寬頻領域兩大新客戶為Blue Origin和Space Backbone ， 預估2028年小量出貨 ；
(6)公司近期透過自有資金與銀行融資取得巨頻科技股權，交易金額不超過17億元，巨頻科技主要業務為高頻高速
互連產品開發與製造，產品領域涵蓋RF、微波、毫米波與高速傳輸模組等，預計於2026年8月合併報表開始挹注
營收營收貢獻，透過併購將低軌衛星產品延伸至毫米波放大器模組與高速連接方案，另外針對AI Datacenter 
Interconnect應用方面，公司積極開發太赫茲(220THz)解決方案，可支援1.6/3.2T傳輸頻寬且適合機櫃內傳輸距
離，目前產品仍在進行認證，最快2027年量產
。綜上所述，預估2026/2027年營收年增77%/70.2%至43.4/73.9
億元，稅後EPS為19.32/38.76元。

短期昇達科本身營運受 S 客戶新舊世代交替而導致出貨放緩，預
計 8 月起恢復動能，然而第 13 次 Starship 測試任務順利完成，
研究部維持正向看待下半年投入商轉後將加速 V3 衛星的部屬進
度。而A 客戶近期也加緊發射衛星 ，7 月底更又再向 FCC 申請 5105
顆 DTC 衛星的部屬計畫，可見整體低軌衛星市場在未來幾年仍處
於蓬勃發展期。綜合以上，研究部預估昇達科 2026 年 EPS 18.55
元，2027 年 EPS 37.55 元，目前 PE 為 36x，雖然短期衛星客戶
拉貨力道較為趨緩 ， 然而從產業面上的動態可知客戶們持續積極規
劃未來發展 ， 因此研究部仍看好昇達科長期營運表現將隨客戶步調
增長，因此維持 50xPER，目標價 1880 元，建議買進。

A 客戶持續擴大衛星部屬規模，S 客戶 Starship 測試順利 
為了能在 2026 年開始在部分地區提出服務，A 客戶今年來已完成
216 顆衛星的部屬，至 7 月底合計 396 顆衛星運行中，此外更再
向 FCC 提出 5105 顆 DTC 服務的星座計畫，預計於 2028 年開始
部屬任務 ， 加計先前通過的二代星系A 客戶合計規劃共約 1.3 萬顆
衛星的規模。近期 S 客戶第 13 次測試任務於 7/23 順利完成，研
究部認為此有助於加速 Starship 投入正式任務中 ，對於 V3 衛星的
部屬進程將帶來實質性的貢獻。除了傳統衛星業務外，昇達科也開
始佈局毫米波功率放大器、太赫茲傳輸等相關技術，預計於 2028
年陸續開始有所貢獻。綜上所述，研究部預估昇達科 2027 年營收
82.1 億元，Y+84.8%，毛利率 62.77%，稅後淨利 25.8 億元，
Y+102.4%，EPS 37.55 元。

結論 
短期昇達科本身營運受 S 客戶新舊世代交替而導致出貨放緩，預
計 8 月起恢復動能，然而第 13 次 Starship 測試任務順利完成，研
究部維持正向看待下半年投入商轉後將加速 V3 衛星的部屬進度。

2006 年 8 月智邦出售股權後，目前公司主要股東為仁寶集團。智易為網通
設備製造廠商之一，早期經營模式主要替品牌廠商進行代工，後由品牌廠商
銷售給終端客戶，公司自 2012 起轉向直供電信營運商客戶，毛利率優於代
工體系。此外公司也已發展為全球最大 IAD 製造商，市佔率超過二成，為台
灣網通代工大廠。2Q26 年營收比重為智慧家庭產品 31.7 %、行動
通訊產品 38.1 %、寬頻固網產品 26.4 %及 其他 3.7 %。

由於智易去年起積極增加記憶體備料 ，公司存貨金額將持續提升。相較 1Q26
季底存貨淨額佔比逾總資產三分之一，2Q26 存貨淨額約 277 億元，佔總資
產金額過半，公司亦將持續根據客戶訂單展望協助備料以確保 2027 年所需
原料無虞。在帳上現金充足的狀況下，除了避免後續缺料問題，公司提前備
料亦有望加速與客戶鎖定合約並討論價格轉嫁，有助智易維持毛利率及保障
出貨順暢，我們預計下半年記憶體漲價對智易毛利率影響甚微，惟將持續關
注被動元件、基板的其餘原物料之價格波動。展望北美網通市場，受惠於美
國基建長期需求，Wifi-7 在提高連接覆蓋度下滲透率快速提升，持續推升營
收規模，考量公司下半年出貨節奏可能受原物料供給有所波動，相對於過往
下半年兩季度營收有明顯變化，我們認為 2H26 兩季度營收將較無淡旺季之
別，整體而言我們仍預估下半年營運表現將優於上半年。

積極切入企業級網通領域，2027 年營收佔比有望達雙位數 
智易亦持續拓展企業網通、車用與衛星通訊等領域發展。近年積極切入的企
業網通產品聚焦中大型企業級 EAP 與 Switch 需求，致意有望受惠於企業客
戶內部的產品規格逐步升級至 WiFi7 之趨勢。預期 2H26 將有相關產品出
貨，客戶數量亦逐步增加。考量企業網通產品單價較高，我們預估在企業級
網通產品 2026 年基期較低的狀況下，2027 年有望迎來翻倍成長，營收占比
將達雙位數，為公司今明年重要成長動能。

投顧預估智易 2026 年營收為 557.4 億元，+5.2% YoY，5G FWA 北美市場
拉貨動能強烈，近年主力 5G 網通產品出貨量皆有雙位數成長，企業網通產
品明年營收有望逐步放量，惟須持續關注記憶體以外之其他原物料成本上漲
對出貨時程之影響。預估全年毛利率為 15.2%，營業利益率為 6.8%， 歸屬母
公司稅後淨利為 30.9 億元，EPS 為 14.04 元。

營 運 分 析 
全球前三大矽晶圓供應商，布局高階與第三代半導體材料 
環球晶圓股份有限公司（6488）成立於 2011 年，由中美矽晶半導體事業分
割成立，總部位於新竹科學園區，為全球前三大、台灣最大矽晶圓供應商，
亦為全球最大非日系矽晶圓廠。公司產品涵蓋  3 至 12 吋拋光、磊晶與  
Silicon-on-Insulator（SOI）晶圓，應用橫跨邏輯 IC、記憶體、功率元件、
車用、工控與射頻通訊等領域，主要客戶包括整合 元件製造商（Integrated 
Device Manufacturer, IDM） 與晶圓代工廠，競爭對手為信越化學、SUMCO、
Siltronic 與 SK Siltron。 
近年公司資本支出重心由既有亞洲據點延伸至美國與歐洲，推動 Texas 12 
吋矽晶圓新廠、Missouri SOI 擴產及義大利相關專案，以支應 AI、高效能
運算（High Performance Computing, HPC）、先進記憶體、矽光與在地化
供應鏈需求。美國商務部已核定對環球晶  Texas 與 Missouri 專案提供  
4.06 億美元補助，其中  Texas 廠將建立美國本土 300mm 矽晶圓量產能
力，Missouri 則聚焦 SOI 晶圓擴產。 
除傳統矽晶圓外，公司亦布局碳化矽（Silicon Carbide, SiC）、特殊晶圓與
方形矽晶圓等高附加價值材料，對應第三代半導體與先進封裝需求。

+16%，反映客戶需求及出貨量回升；毛利率20.6%，較 26Q1 下滑 0.2 個百
分點，主要因去年低迷市況下議定之價格尚未反映近期需求回升，加上新廠
由建置階段進入客戶認證及產能爬坡，驗證、人力、設備運轉及折舊成本增
加；其中 GWA 自 4 月起提列廠房折舊。隨客戶認證、產量及稼動率提升，
成本吸收可望逐步改善。營業利益 14.23 億元，營業利益率9.4%，稅後淨利
37.78 億元，EPS 7.90元。 
若排除主要全球擴產專案，26H1 營收將由 292 億元降至約 275 億元，毛利
率則由 20.7%提高至 32.4%，顯示現階段毛利率壓力主要來自新產能初期成
本，而非既有產線獲利能力轉弱。公司預估2026 年折舊約 120 億元，26H1
接近 50 億元，26H2因 GWA 新增設備及 Missouri 12 吋 SOI 開始爬坡，折
舊將略高於 26H1，未來數季仍將逐步增加。

Siltronic 評價利益低於原估，下修 2026年 EPS 
26Q2 EPS 7.90 元，低於前次預估 11.27元，主要因 Siltronic 相關評價利益
低於原估。環球晶除持有 Siltronic 股份外，德國子公司另有連結 Siltronic 股
價之認股權負債，兩者均按市價評價；26Q2 股價季內先升後回落，認股權
負債之反向評價進一步放大業外波動。 
研究部將 2026 年 EPS由 27.92 元下修至 21.69元，主要反映 26Q2業外收
益低於原估 、 新廠成本吸收較慢及Novara火災影響 ；2027年 EPS則由 36.13
元小幅下修至 34.12 元，本業成長方向維持不變。

既有產線接近滿載，先進 12吋供需轉緊 
SEMI 統計顯示，26Q2 全球矽晶圓出貨面積達 35.73 億平方英吋，QoQ 
+9.1%／YoY +7.4%，成長動能由 AI 相關先進邏輯與記憶體，逐步延伸至功
率元件、光子及工業應用，顯示矽晶圓需求已由庫存調整轉向實質出貨回升。
環球晶既有 12 吋、8 吋、6 吋及 GaN-on-Si 產線已接近滿載，部分先進 12
吋產品供給亦開始吃緊，反映高階規格需求改善幅度高於整體市場。 
SOI 成長則主要集中於矽光子應用。環球晶表示，Missouri 12 吋 SOI需求強
勁，RF-SOI 及矽光子產品已進入小量生產；Soitec 最新營運亦顯示，26Q1 
Photonics-SOI 銷售量較去年同期成長逾一倍，並預期 27 年 Photonics-SOI
營收將較 26 年超過 1億美元的基期再成長逾一倍，反映 AI 資料中心高速光
互連正帶動 Photonics-SOI 進入快速放量階段。 
研究部預期 2027 年環球晶營收成長除受整體矽晶圓出貨延續中高個位數成
長帶動，亦將受惠GWA先進 12 吋、Missouri SOI及 Novara 12吋新產能放
量。其中 SOI 及矽光子目前基期仍低，但成長速度明顯高於傳統矽晶圓，對
產品組合及毛利率的貢獻將顯著。

他主要產線稼動率已接近滿載，可立即調度之備援產能有限，部分出貨影響
仍難以完全避免。 
火災前，公司原預期26Q3 營收季增幅度可高於 26Q2 的 8.8%；事故後則下
修為透過跨廠調度及產能移轉，力求維持營收季增。研究部預估 26Q3 營收
161.88 億元（QoQ +6.4%／YoY +11.7%） ，反映Novara 停工壓抑原有成長
幅度，惟既有產線需求及稼動率維持高檔；毛利率預估 21.8%，營業利益
20.23 億元，營業利益率 12.5%，稅後淨利 22.89 億元，EPS 4.79元。 
圖二、環球晶(6488)各季營收及獲利走勢預估

資料來源：Cmoney；兆豐投顧預估

評價倍數由 48 倍下修至 34 倍，主要反映 2027 年 LTA 價格仍待協商，價格
改善將依產品與合約逐步反映，加上新廠折舊與初期成本仍將壓抑毛利率。
雖下修獲利與評價假設，不過股價自前次報告後已明顯修正，目前評價低於
合理水準；同時既有產線稼動率回升、部分先進12 吋產品供需轉緊，GWA、
Missouri SOI及 Novara新產能亦將於 2027年逐步貢獻 ， 支撐本業獲利成長 。 
研究部預估環球晶 2026／2027 年 EPS 為 21.69／34.12 元，前次預估為
27.92／36.13元。雖然目標價下修至 1,160 元，潛在上漲空間仍有 33.0%，
現價對應 2027 EPS 仍低於合理評價，投資評等由「區間操作」調升至「逢
低買進」。

1 
6526 達發(Airoha Co.)

報告日期： 2026/08/05 研 究 員：方姿婷  (Lesley Fang) 
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 達發為網通晶片廠，產品涵蓋 BlueTooth、Ethernet  
達發(6526)為通訊晶片廠商，產品組合為高階 AI 物聯網(含藍芽音
訊、衛星定位)佔 50% 、網通基礎建設(固網寬頻、乙太網)佔 50%、
其他(九暘、STB 、DSP…) ，其中 2026 年光通訊佔約 5%與乙太網、
九暘合計約 20% 。在 AI PC 產品規格與展望方面，預期 AI PC 擁有
更大計算力和更大記憶體容量的裝置，PC 多數配備高端設備，諸
如：Wi-Fi 7、2.5G 或 5.0G PON、AI Audio CODEC 和 AI 攝像頭等，
透過集團資源整合(合併亞信、參與九暘私募案後)可望在 PC 的高
速傳輸介面有所斬獲；此外，參與九暘私募也預期在工業乙太網
POE 供電市場有所成效；展望 2026 年，營收成長來自於網通寬頻
穩健成長，加速 10G PON、25G PON、50G PON 持續成長與滲透當
中。達發除自身 PON 產品規格演進之外，也會攜手聯發科(2454)
集團的 WiFi 平台 ， 提供同級產品中最低功耗的解決方案 ， 展望 2026
年，達發受惠的固網寬頻和乙太網業務在歐洲及亞太地區復甦顯
著，其中網通基礎建設、固網、寬頻主要受惠歐美第一線、第二
線營運商專案貢獻所致。

二. 長期 WiFi 產品升級至 WiFi7，達發將為受惠廠商 
宏遠投顧觀察，在家用與商用終端寬頻接取設備方面，參照過往
W i F i 產品汰換週期，市場預期在 2 0 2 4 年~ 2 0 2 5 年間，因應
Broadcom(博通) Wi-Fi 7 主晶片的發表時程於 2H22 、 2H23 開始陸續
釋出，Wi-Fi 7 裝置會於 2024 年~2025 年進入產品換機潮，隨著無
線連結速率提升，搭載 WAN、LAN 接取孔的 Wi-Fi AP/Router、
Switch、PON 光纖網路、電視 Cable Modem、5G 網路終端用戶設備
(CPE)等，未來會朝向無線寬頻升級邁進。宏遠投顧推估 Wi-Fi 主
要應用於 AP/Router、Broadband、PC、TV、ioT 等應用，預估 2023
年 WiFi-6 於 PC 、 AP Rourer 滲透率會從 50~60%再往上提升至 70% ，
相當於 2024 年提升 5~10%。Wi-Fi 7 認證標準也已確立，初期滲透
率約 5~10%，Wi-Fi 7 晶片組 ASP 會是 Wi-Fi 6/6e 的倍數成長。初
期以歐美電信營運商( A T & T、V e r i z o n、T - M o b i l e、V o d a f o n e、
Telefonica 等)家庭用戶數推估 AP/Router 用量，粗估一年有 7,000
萬套，Wi-Fi 7 晶片組 ASP 相對高，評估一年產值可達 NTD$ 
800~1,000 億元之間，再加上其他領域的 Wi-Fi 模組應用滲透率提
升之下，支援網速升級從 Wi-Fi 6/6e 升級至 Wi-Fi 7 晶片組商機汰
換可期。台灣廠商在 Wi-Fi 7 商機會先從高階 PC、AP/Router、手

三.  各項產品開發，朝向高速傳輸、光通訊業務發展 
藍芽音頻晶片達發藍芽音頻晶片隨市佔率攀升(因美系晶片龍頭廠
近年將資源投入車載、Edge AI 等項目，對消費電子產品投入力道
降低)，使得藍芽音頻晶片，隨達發市佔率達 20%~30%，達發往品
牌與多元應用進行，包括商務頭戴式耳機、電競式頭戴耳機、助
聽輔聽器等醫療等級晶片拓展。2025 年 8 月份，法說會中指出助
輔聽相關產品在 2024 年底已經量產出貨 100 萬顆以上，並推出超
過 50 款通過 FDA 認證的產品，持續導入更先進製程。此外，導航
衛星晶片公司長期也有與聯發科集團合作進行車載布局，尚需時
間發酵。寬頻通訊晶片業務希冀朝歐美市場拓展，2H24 已出貨美
國 Tier II 運營商與歐洲 Tier I 運營商(Deutsche Telecom)等客戶。光
通訊晶片達發已開始供貨，達發提供 PAM-4DSP(12nm)電晶片，內
含 SerDes 高速介面與 DSP，支援400G 光通訊收發模組，公司有 2
家模組廠客戶(市場預期台系光通訊模組廠商為主) ， 應有更多來自
中國的客戶，2H25 Sample Out 800G AOC 晶片。針對 TIA 阻抗放
大器在測試中 ， 2025 年開始出貨 。 未來光通訊 PAM-4 DSP+LD+TIA
整合成一個模組後出貨給客戶機率提升。展望 2026 年，光通訊業
務單通道 50G 的 PAM-4DSP 搭配 TIA 阻抗放大器出貨 、 單通道 100G
已於 4Q25 Tape out，2026 年中搭配 TIA 步入量產階段。(針對光通
訊業務，聯發科提供 Scale-Up SOC 高速傳輸 Serdes；達發則是專
注於 Scale-Out PAM-4 DSP 與 TIA 單通道 100G/200G Serdes IP 佈
署，強調低功耗解決方案導入美系 CSP AI 伺服器中)；此次 26 年
8 月座談中提及，達發光通訊 50G PAM-4 DSP 受惠北美 CSP 拉貨
轉強，光通訊業務 YoY 4 倍以上。光通訊 100G 產品，已經過多家
模組廠驗證，預期 2027 年光通訊業務 YoY 3 倍以上。此外，達發
200G SerDes IP 建置完成同步規劃 TIA 品項，光通訊 200G 採用先
進製程且對於(聯發科)採取收取授權金方式認列。

隨著串流影音與 XR(虛擬實境技術)逐漸成熟，使用者對於無線高
頻寬傳輸要求殷切，帶動了 802.11ad、802.11ax、Mesh、5G 等各種
高頻寬無線通訊技術快速成長。未來十年，5G 是開啟移動終端與
萬物互聯之技術開端 ， 市場預期 2010 年全球有 53 億移動終端 ， 到
2020 年達到 107 億，至 2030 年成長到 170 億，尤其是中國市場移
動用戶月流量將持續大幅增長至 2030 年達 130 倍之高，所帶來的
經濟規模十分巨大。此外，根據 Gartner 預估，Wi-Fi 6 企業與中
小型商務用戶產值將從 2019 年 2.5 億美元，到 2023 年 52.2 億美
元，年複合成長率達+114%，國內生產 WiFi-6 相關產品網通業者
包含啟碁、正文、明泰、神準、合勤控等廠商，均有機會受惠於
WiFi-6 企業端產品先行汰換的換機潮，預期將可持續 2~3 年待
WiFi-6 產品價格下降落至消費者願意換機之甜蜜價格區間，市場
預期在 2024 年~2025 年間，因應 Broadcom(博通) Wi-Fi 7 主晶片的
發表時程，Wi-Fi 7 裝置也會於 2025 年進入產品換機潮。

研究部維持富世達買進投資建議，主係 : (1) 2Q 毛利率略優於預
期，主因 QD 製程持續優化，抵銷營收季減之衝擊；(2)隨著 NV 
GPU、兩家 CSP ASIC 平台逐漸放量，2H26 營運顯著優於 1H26；(3) 
下半年三折手機機種備貨積極，蘋果加入市場有望活絡整體滲透率；
(4)新增 Rack Manifold QD 產品。(5)目前評價已自高檔回落。綜上
所述，研究部上修 2027 年營收至276 億元(原估 263 億元)，EPS 上
修至 98.18 元(原估 92.68 元)。然而考量 2H26 各平台放量時點認列
仍存不確定性，僅給予 25 倍本益比，目標價下修至 2450 元。

重點摘要： 
1. 2Q營收達成率僅88%，主係手機、伺服器產品面臨轉換期 
2Q26營收37億元(原估42億元)，季減10.6%、年增42.7%，營收
達成率僅88%，低於預期 ， 主係手機/伺服器同步面臨新舊產品
轉換期。毛利率34.0%(原估32.7%)，季增1.7pts，優於預期，
2Q產品組合：伺服器55.6%、手機38%、NB 5.6% (對比1Q伺服
器56.5%、手機37.7%、NB 5.2%)，產品組合無好轉，但毛利率
仍可季增主係QD製程持續優化 。 營益率27.9%(原估27.8%)，季
增1.1pts， 符合預期 ；EPS 12.38元(原估13.45元)， 低於預期。

2. 2H26動能加速，NV/ASIC陸續放量 
展望2H26，在手機部分，中系客戶三折機種積極備貨，ASP可
較前一代維持 ，而隨著蘋果加入折疊機市場， 整體摺疊機滲透
率可望提升；在QD部分，研究部預期VR平台下半年開始放量、
A客戶/G客戶ASIC QD產品亦可在3Q/4Q陸續批量出貨，整體
2H26出貨動能將顯著大於 1H26，且預估皆有達雙位數逐季成
長 。 然考量各平台放量時點差異 ， 故研究部微幅下修3Q26營收
至44億元(原估47億元)，EPS下修至14.99元(原估16.04元)。

3. QD/滑軌產能全面擴充，新增Rack Manifold貢獻 
產能部分，管理層透露QD月產能約300萬顆，滑軌產能約35萬
套，27年產能持續擴充。根據供應鏈調查，各平台快接頭用量
較前一代增加(預估VR約450顆、T3約540顆、TPU約192顆)，除
了先前這些專案外，富世達未來更新增rack manifold相關生
意。目前QD ASP目前仍可維持先前水準，並未降價。

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要批露及免責聲明  2

4. 上修27年獲利預估，維持買進投資建議 
綜上所述，研究部下修2026年營收至177億元(原估184億元，
年增42.7%)，EPS下修至59.34元(原估61.06元)；惟隨VR200、
AWS ASIC/TPU陸續放量，加上QD產能擴充、rack manifold等
新產品貢獻 ， 研究部上修2027年營收至276億元(原估263億元 ，
年增56.0%)，EPS上修至98.18元(原估92.68元)。然而，考量
2H26各平台放量時點認列仍存在不確定性，給予25倍本益比，
目標價由2600元下修至2450元(2027 EPS*25PER)。

求較強，公司也將 2026 年營收從 820~850 億上調 850~870 億美元；

能瓶頸限制，預計將在 2027 年全面展開國際市場大規模上市 。至於
三重受體促效劑 Retatrutide ，現有臨床數據已足以在全球申請肥胖、
阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症及膝關節炎疼痛等適應症，公司預計 1Q27 在
美申請 BLA 。

⚫ 仁大資訊為一站式系統整合商，深耕金融製造並拓展 AI 與海外市場  
仁大資訊成立於 1999 年，為專業資訊服務系統整合商，主要提供企業客戶一
站式全方位資訊解決方案。公司主要業務包括軟硬體銷售、維護合約與勞務服
務三大類。維護合約負責 Endpoint 、IT 機房及網路設備的定期保養與管理，勞
務服務則提供 IT 駐點、機房搬遷及系統整合服務。 1H26 主要營收組合結構方
面商品銷售佔 81%、維護合約佔 14%、勞務服務佔 5%及其他約 1%，主要客戶
來自金融業佔 36% 、製造業佔 47% 、電信業佔 5%及其他佔 13% 。公司採取高
度整合的一站式服務模式，具備從系統規劃、建置到維護保固的完整能力，在
全台設有 13 個服務據點，擁有超過 740 張原廠技術認證，提供即時且高品質
的技術支援。為強化競爭力，仁大資訊於 2024 年併購專注於 FinTech 與 AI 應
用的金腦數位 ， 並於 2025 年 3 月成立越南子公司 ， 因應半導體客戶需求於 2026
年 7 月設立美國子公司，未來布局海外市場預計後續擴展至泰國、日本與菲律
賓 。 截至2026 年 6 月底員工人數 478 人，1Q26 普通股股本約新台幣 3.01 億元 。

⚫ 仁大資訊的競爭優勢  
仁大資訊具備綿密的全台服務網絡，設有 13 個服務據點，搭配料件倉庫及自
有物流車隊，可提供高密度、快速到場的維運服務，形成具高度在地化且不易
複製的服務門檻。除傳統電話及 Email 報修外，公司亦導入 LINE 智慧報修平
台，持續提升服務效率與差異化價值；同時具備 7×24 客服中心及正 職工程師
團隊，可提供 2 小時到場、 4 小時完修等高標準服務，有效降低客戶委外及資
安風險，對高度重視系統穩定性與服務即時性的金融機構尤其具吸引力。  
此外，公司長期深耕金融及製造業，累積多家長期合作客戶及大型專案執行經
驗，具備良好的客戶黏著度與專案複製能力；搭配超過 300 名工程師及多項國
際專業認證，建立涵蓋系統建置、維運及技術整合的完整服務能力。在海外布
局方面，公司於 2025 年 3 月成立越南子公司，並因應半導體客戶需求於 2026
年 7 月設立美國子公司 ， 未來海外據點可望進一步拓展至泰國 、 日本及菲律賓，
持續提升海外服務量能，協助台商解決海外資訊系統建置、維運及跨區溝通等
需求，逐步打造台商企業值得信賴的海外資訊服務後盾。
